---
title: "Main map"
---

```{r}
#| label: main-map
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| 
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

dat <- read.csv("intermediates/final_dat.csv")

cities_locations <- readRDS("./intermediates/cities_locations.RDS")

group_by(dat, city) |> 
  summarise(nice_doi = paste0(DOI, collapse = " <br> "),
            n = length(DOI)) |> 
  inner_join(cities_locations) |> 
  mutate(clickable_link = paste0(
      "<div class='marker-container'><a href='city.html?", city, "' target='_blank' class='marker-link'>", n, 
      "</a><span class='city-tooltip'>", city, "</span></div>"
    )) |>
  leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 10)) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  setView(lng = 15, lat = 49, zoom = 4) |> 
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    label = ~lapply(clickable_link, htmltools::HTML),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      noHide = TRUE,
      direction = "center",
      textOnly = FALSE,
      interactive = TRUE,
      style = list(
        "font-size" = "21px",
        "font-weight" = "bold",
        "color" = "#2c3e50",
        "cursor" = "pointer",
        "border-radius" = "6px",
        "min-width" = "30px",
        "height" = "30px",
        "text-align" = "center",
        "line-height" = "19px"
      )
    )
  )
```
